value.residual: Lean proves the compact one-owner atomic state transition and the bounded model couples effect, event, version, and receipt. Runtime: the whole-snapshot Turso adapter's atomic failure/reopen tests were removed in #2764 (not currently covered); no retained runtime test is promoted for this claim. Normalized canonical tables, cell-boundary commit atomicity (T6-DST-1, #2583), and an extracted implementation correspondence argument remain open. Former evidence exercised a deleted subsystem or adapter and is no longer promoted. The L1 reference checks single-object atomic updates, and its extracted successor theorem covers only the version increment/overflow fragment; no whole-transition correspondence is claimed. The extracted commit admission driver (crates/norn-kernel/src/commit_order.rs run_stages) is proved, for every implementation of the stage bodies, to run the fourteen admission stages in the written order and to end admission at the first refusal (scripts/verify-kernel-commit-aeneas.sh, #718 P8 K-A); the stage bodies, the stage dispatch in commit_check.rs and the host apply are not covered by that theorem. The extracted decider core (crates/norn-kernel/src/decider_fold.rs) is proved, for every decider and every ledger, to fold events as the left fold of evolve, to replay as that fold from the initial state, to run a turn's checks in the written order (world writable, decision, envelope caps, perform outside main) before folding the decision's own events, and so to reach a live state equal to the replay of the ledger its accepted turns wrote (scripts/verify-kernel-decider-aeneas.sh, #718 P8 K-B); the step glue in decider.rs and envelope.rs, each decider's own decide and evolve, and the host apply are not covered by that theorem.
